mentions.name: Solanda
mentions.description: A zero-dependency UI library built on native web components, designed to help with UI development without bloating a project. It works with Vue/Nuxt (tested) as well as React, Angular, and Svelte, and was just made public after a year of use in the author's personal projects. Licensed under AGPLv3, with open consideration of switching to MIT due to adoption concerns.
mentions.problem: UI development tooling often bloats projects with dependencies; this library avoids that with zero dependencies and native web components.
mentions.source_excerpt: A new UI library made with zero dependencies (native web components). I just made it public as I actually use it for my personal projects since past year.
mentions.author: cristodcgomez
